The first vist was perfect 5 stars, but the 2nd one was disappointing.  Regarding of the food quality and taste. Yakasaki Sushi: Average taste I could not taste the lobster as the cheese cream overcomes the taste of the other ingredients or the portion of the lobster was too little to be tasted. Angus beef with trafel: We could not complete the dish, the beef has undesirable smell and taste. It looks like it was not fresh. Also, it has a weird texture I have never experinced with any beef befor. The onion pieces  were big and uncooked. Mixed noodle with oyster sauce: nothing special about it. the shrimp was rubbery. Crispy honey chicken: the only thing we ate that day, I do recommend it. The onion pieces were big and uncooked. Iced lemon tea: Homemade, it is good, but not the best. Strawberry Mojito: below average. Price: very high in comparison to the new dishes' portion and the food quality. Service and Restaurant atmosphere: it is great, and the service is fast. No waiting time. I do not recommend it at all unless they return back to their old flavour and quality.

My absolute favorite brunch spot in Dammam. When visiting Saudi for a second time I had to go to Parker's because I couldn't get the memories of the food out of my head. But the most delicious thing on the menu is the Granola French Toast. I've never in my life had such a good french toast as this one. The ambiance and the service is splendid and the staff is very friendly and hands-on.

This authentic Thai restaurant has become my culinary paradise, and I can't get enough of their amazing Tom Yum Soup. With consistent food quality, fast service, and perfect iced tea, it's an absolute gem. Their Tom Yum Soup is a flavor explosion that tantalizes the taste buds with its perfect blend of spiciness, sourness, and aromatic herbs. Each spoonful is a delightful journey to Thai culinary heaven. Equally impressive is their Pad Thai, a stir-fried noodle dish that is a harmonious symphony of flavors. The restaurant's commitment to consistent food quality is commendable. Every visit guarantees the same exceptional taste and freshness that keeps me coming back for more. And the best part? The service is fast, ensuring that you're promptly served without compromising the quality of the dishes. To accompany the flavorful meal, their iced tea is a refreshing delight. Perfectly brewed and balanced, it complements the bold flavors of the Thai cuisine flawlessly. It's a must-visit destination for Thai food enthusiasts and anyone seeking an unforgettable dining adventure.

It’s our first time in Khobar and a friend recommended this place. As you enter the restaurant, there is a mini seafood market where lots of different kinds of fish, lobsters and prawns were on display. We ordered faskar and salmon, fried and grilled respectively. The seafood tomyum is a must try if you like a sour-spicy-taste soup. The calamari is so-so as it’s thickly cut. Would have been better if it’s thinner and crispier. They look like breaded chicken strips for me. The steamed mixed vegetables and the seafood salad were above par. Pricewise, it’s affordable especially if you’re in groups. Their serving is huge. If you love seafood and asian foods, try this place. Vegetarian options: Salad options in the menu. Parking: Pay parking on site. Prepare some coins. 3SAR per hour.

Wheelchair accessibility: Wheelchair access is available along with an elevator to the first floor .

Wow! I just had to write a review about Piatto Restaurant. They have the best Italian food I've had in a long time. The Rustica pizza was incredible. The crust was amazing - crispy on the outside and soft and chewy on the inside. The toppings were all fresh and flavorful, and the cheese was perfect. The lasagna was just as good. The pasta was cooked perfectly, and the sauce was rich and meaty.  It tasted like real Italian lasagna should! But the best part of the night wasn't even the food (although that was amazing).  Our server, Mr. Mahboob, was the nicest person we've ever met at a restaurant. He was super helpful, explained everything on the menu, and made sure we had everything we needed.  He really made our night special. If you're looking for delicious Italian food and friendly service, Piatto Restaurant is the place to go! I highly recommend it.

It is unlikely that I will go again.

A good steak should be warm, juicy, and tender, but this was none of those things. To make matters worse, the restaurant did not provide any salt and pepper. Seasoning is crucial to bringing out the best in a steak, and without it, the dish was bland and uninspired. I had high hopes for this dining experience, but the lack of attention to such basic details as serving temperature and seasoning broke my heart. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend LASCENE based on my recent visit. There are many other places where you can enjoy a properly cooked and seasoned steak, and I suggest seeking them out instead.

I brought my friend to this restaurant last night for the unlimited steak and chicken deal, hoping for a delightful dining experience. However, the reality was far from my expectations. Despite being a repeat customer, the serving size was disappointing, and the service was painfully slow. It felt like an eternity before our next order arrived, making it impossible to enjoy the so-called "unlimited" offer. The lack of guests in the restaurant only emphasized the glaring issue of delayed service. The prolonged waiting time seemed more like a deliberate tactic to test our patience rather than a genuine effort to provide a pleasant dining experience. By the time the next meal finally made its way to our table, any remnants of hunger had long dissipated. It's disheartening to see such a promising promotion fall flat due to inefficiency and lackluster service. After this underwhelming experience, it's safe to say that I will not be returning to this establishment. I strongly advise against falling for their enticing promotions, as the reality fails to live up to the hype. Save yourself the frustration and seek out a restaurant that values its customers' time and satisfaction. I regret wasting my time and money here, and I cannot in good conscience recommend this place to anyone, not even to my followers.

Although the ambience was good, the waiter's service was excellent, and the manager's visit a pleasant surprise; the food was an even greater surprise. Being South African, my girlfriends and I expected true Indian style cooking. Although all the dishes were obviously cooked with great care and the Indian spices necessary because they smelled really great, they all had a "sweet" taste to them. They were also lacking in the traditional "Indian Sting" that comes from the chilli or masala used. I ordered the Dum Briyani, and it was the best dish on the table. We promised to visit again, but next time, we will order "spicier and hotter" dishes, like the true Indian cooking we know. Hopefully, the chef will do it justice.

Overall, it was a very good experience and deserves multiple visits. If you’re a kebab and grill lover, you must try Grillo💯💯.

I have been to this place thrice with my friends because we love to eat their “the gangs, pasta and burgers”. Every time we came, all the staffs treated us well, but last night (my 4th time) was very different! Me and my 3 friends had a table already with 4 seats and while ordering, I told the waiter to reserve the next table behind us because some of our friends were coming and he said okay. When they delivered our orders, I reminded the waiter about the reserved table and he replied “okay, no problem". When my other friends arrived and sat at the said table, then waiting to order again, they told us to go because it was reserved by other customers. Really?!!! 😡 What a disrespectful night!!💔 I told the reception about my concern, but they didn't try to fix it!  So, some of us transferred to another restaurant, leaving our other friends eating because we didn’t have a table. Please, as much as possible, you should inform us ahead of time if there are any changes to our requests! I write this review because I don't want this to happen to other customers. It is just so heart breaking!

description: A welcome newcomer to the burgeoning restaurant scene in Abqaiq town. It's a small intimate space that is very well decorated. Our sushi rolls were to die for, which was a wonderful surprise to my tastebuds. I only gave 4 stars for atmosphere as it would be nice to have had some low background music or perhaps soothing water sound playing in the background instead of silence. There are only 3 sit down booths for dine-in so go early to get a table. Highly recommended. I will be back to try the other items on their menu.

I've had this place in my plan to go list for a while, I went to it recently and this is how my visit went. The place feels like a lost heaven! Looks marvellous from the outside and the inside, it does transition you to somewhere else, one of my friends thought I traveled somewhere from the pics as well. The service is superb! They have lunch offer which I found to be spectacular! 49sr for a soup, main dish and a drink, based on the main dish the offer varies in price starting from 49 and goes up. I got mushroom soup which was really good! I added pepper and slight lemon squeeze. The cola is cola. The main dish was fine, the chicken tasted like shawerma chicken, the pasta was good. The volume of the soup and the main dish is huge! I'd say the amount of food is for 1.5 person, this is unreal so get two offers as a group of three and you all well be set. Overall, I'm happy that I tried this place, it was an experience indeed. From the entrance to the exist. I'm definitely recommending this place!

Came here for lunch with my family. Was not disappointed! There were three entrances, one for the family section, one for the couples section, and one for the singles section. The menu has a very wide range of options, from Arab foods to Western foods, and Al-Tanour nailed all of them! The food is well-presented and tastes delicious, each with a different and amazing mix of spices. I strongly recommend getting the Quinoa Salad, it tastes very strong and is very tempting for a salad. The atmosphere is nice and calm with beautiful music in the background, it was so nice and fortunately the staff was nice enough to give us the name of the song when we asked. They were really patient and welcoming and the service was extremely fast considering the quality of the food. It is slightly expensive, but the food is definitely worth it. All in all, this restaurant is definitely worth visiting for both lunch and dinner, for all dishes seem delicious. Vegetarian options: There are plenty of salads. Kid-friendliness: Kids are allowed inside but most are disciplined well which adds to the calm aura of the place. Wheelchair accessibility: There are multiple ramps outside of each entrance, very convenient for handicapped customers.

A lot of locals were recommending this place to me as to a tourist. The purpose was for me to see a traditional building as it used t be made, and to taste some local food. I must agree that the place looks great and it's surely interesting for any tourist. But the food itself was average, or slightly above average. What I found interesting is that the place offers besides regular tables at common area also various dining rooms which you choose. There are even doors on those rooms so you have privacy when eating. When staff gets to the room to take your order or to bring your meal, they always knock. I recommend to try Arabic coffee here, as I liked it a lot. It's served with a date and it has very good taste, full of cardamon and spices.

restaurant_name: Red Table Restaurant- Abdullah Fouad Branch
description: This restaurant is located in Dammam Area Location 8931 Prince Mohammed Bin Fahad Road Abdullah Fouad, Near Stadium Signal, Dammam 32236 Saudi Arabia Red Table is the new restaurant from critically acclaimed artisanal Indian restaurant owner Naif Al Otaibi and Executive Chef Ebou. Red Table holds up to its name with its bright, casual atmosphere; “unapologetically” authentic Indian food. We at Red Table believe that food is a conversation of life and want to recreate that dialogue through our ingredient-focused menu. By evoking hints of their own nostalgia, Chef Ebou have created traditional dishes the way they’re meant to be cooked: with a variety of herbs and spices made in-house while staying true to India. It’s unpretentious—think Butter Chicken, Dum Biriyani, and traditional South delicacies. Come with your spice-appreciating friends, and join us for a sensational feast! The best restaurants serving Egyptian food in the Eastern Province, whether in the Dammam branch or the Khobar branch. But the Dammam branch is distinguished by its beautiful location on the Corniche and the most wonderful view. The quality is the same in the two branches, but the experience this time from the Dammam branch is characterized by enjoyable sessions overlooking the Corniche. Vegetarian options: You can get their vegetarian food in the Egyptian way and according to your request or the additions you need . Dietary restrictions: The restaurant is subject to dietary restrictions within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and you can view them in the menu during your order. As a joke... As you know, Egyptian food is not subject to Dietary restrictions... It is very, very delicious food that makes you eat more ... Parking: The Dammam branch features plenty of parking spaces, whether in front of, behind, or next to the restaurant, all of which are free Kid-friendliness: The place welcomes children and has designated chairs that you can obtain upon request . Wheelchair accessibility: The Dammam branch has seating areas on the second floor. What distinguishes the branch is the provision of 2 elevators to serve customers to avoid crowding when going up or down, and the provision of exits that help customers to serve customers for Wheelchair accessibility .

I saw the high rating and decided to try it myself 😴 The restaurant is large and spacious and the seating is comfortable There is one note that I did not like, which is the delay because... They wait for each request to be prepared, then they answer it for you once and in full I don't like this behavior in restaurants at all, and we always make sure they don't do it wrong, and this time we forgot to tell them. His wife brings the appetizers and then brings anything that is ready so we can enjoy the food while it is hot and fresh and not cold before its turn. Come for orders: - Lentil soup, to be honest, I have never tasted it - Spicy potatoes 10/10, very delicious - Hummus 10/10, balanced and delicious - Potato balls with chicken 10/10 We got fresh, fried tomato balls. They are a good size and filling - Caesar salad 3/10 is full of sauce to the point that the lettuce has wilted from too much of it and lost its texture and has no crunch. - Sajiya kibbeh, to be honest, I haven’t tasted it -Feathers 9/10 - Meat Fakhar 10/10, it was missing a little salt. I added it and it turned out delicious. The last thing I remembered was its picture after we ate it. - Mixed grill 9/10. What I liked most was the shish tawook -Kebab Khashkhash 8/10 The food is clean, frankly, and the method of presentation is nice, and it is one of the restaurants that you repeat more than once, and their bread is delicious, and it comes to you hot, frankly, it is second to none 😍

1990's time realm with It's specific atmosphere and smell, with something i didn't expect which the crowds of all the Original Italian food lovers all over the place, although they have a great view    on the Kornaish, but we have realised that the whole building 🏢 have blinded the Northern view of the Kornaish for no reason, but it is okay and have nothing to do with the restaurant evaluation any how, except for the double layer entrance door🚪they have, that suppose to stop flys 💸 from entring the place but they exist inside any way 7/10. 2- The hospitality: The crew were super nice 🙂 and prefer, this is what you can call true pro service from the heart ❤️ 8/10. 3- Our order and the food quality: We have ordered 2 of the main flagship dishes they have which are, Tarabani Con Salsa wish is Bread 🍞 , vegetables 🍅 , Olive    and Butter   , the ingredients were 6/10 fresh, the look was beautiful 7/10, the taste was one of the best with the Fettuccini Verdi Gratinate but not this good with the Tarabani Con Salsa Mugnaia 6/10, and the quality of the food was (for the price) 4/10 so far. 4- The experience conclusion: It was an Italian classy luxurious experience with one of the best views    in Jeddah , as it is one of the oldest and best Italian restaurants in Jeddah city 🏙️ , of course i am the one who ordered the Tarabani Con Salsa Mugnaia and i felt guilty ordering it with the wish that i have ordered the Nagil Santini dish as i have been asked for the flagship dishes there and Tarabani was the one 🤦🏻 , the guilt have encresed when i tasted it , it was delicious but didn't fullfill my expectations , and it might be because of the high calories it had , despite all such sad part we have enjoyed the time to the fullest with High quality delicious dishes, magnificent services, wonderful view of the Sea ⛵ 🌊 which make it one of the glorious Italian restaurants in Jeddah city in my opinion with such unforgotten advantages which are very limited regretfully and if there is another, refer/share it so we can try it out , by the way, they got a functional Piano 🎹 inside if you want to play some 7/10. 5- The 𝕏-Score is: 45 / 70 1st- Fratelli La restaurant_name: مطعم كذا ميزا- Katha Meza restaurant
description: After greetings and peace The reception and treatment were wonderful, nice, respectful, and appropriately helpful. 9 out of 10 Location and cleanliness: The place has indoor seating, privacy for families, and outside, overlooking the street, it is open. The cleanliness is beautiful, and there are no comments except attention to the location of the sinks. 7.5 out of 10 Food and prices: The price is a little exaggerated for the size of the meal, but the taste and food are worth trying. Delicious and very suitable. There is nothing to note, but the taste of coriander in the potatoes is clear to me. The rice came cold and had lumps in it as if it had come from the end of the pot. 7.5 out of 10 The wait depends on the time and the order takes 20 minutes and I got 7 out of 10 (the order came quickly, perhaps because there was no crowding or because the service was special and fast) Overall rating: 7.75 out of 10 The coriander notes in the potatoes are clear... A small bottle of water costs half a riyal and is sold for one riyal... The size of the cup of juice is very small for the price... and the rice is cold and has lumps in it... Worth a try Best regards, Abu Amal

Nakheel has been always a sure favourite for good food coupled with good ambience since over the past  30 years. Especially if you want to take guests or 1st timers visiting jeddah. What is really nice is when you enter and how it really takes you back in time. Everything ordered on the menu was really good. Service was quick as there was no crowd on a weekday evening. Prices are definitely high end, for example a plate of 5 pieces of falafel is 27 riyals. One thing disappointing was that we  were told by the cashier that outdoor seating requires ordering sheesha. Which we didnt want. However when we asked for our sheesha the waiter said it was not a requirement saying that the cashier was not truthful. Furthermore when paying in cash make sure you ask for your change otherwise the waiter will assume its his tip. Parking: Finding parking during weeknights is ok, on the weekends you have to park really far and walk a bit Wheelchair accessibility: They have ramps everywhere to get to the seating area but the seating arrangement requires you to move to the seat.

Our reservation was made for brunch at 3pm on 26th of January, we came in to celebrate my husband’s birthday, but unfortunately it turned out to be a disaster. Service from reception was good upon arrival and our waiter was prompt in taking the order for us and explain which dishes we would be able to enjoy as we have some dietary requirements. Prawn crackers and water to start took already over 10 minutes to touch our table even though we were the only ones in the restaurant; from here, everything started to go downhill: Our appetisers (dim sum) took ages to arrive to then be left with an empty table for 50 minutes waiting for our mains, rice and noodles - upon checking we were served after 10 more minutes with our noodles and rice, waited an extra 15 minutes and then our first (out of 4!) main course finally came. At this stage our rice was already cold and we refused to get any more food since it already was 4:45pm and barely any food was served to us even though the whole place was empty until 4pm. The manager was nowhere to be seen, until we asked for him - nonetheless we weren’t impressed at all with his reaction as it seemed quite normal for this to happen. We love Shang’s Palace all over the world and when we have the chance we visit, but unfortunately Jeddah’s one has been the worst by far to date. Birthday celebration was ruined!

My wife and I had a pleasant night out at Shang Plus. It was our first visit, and we ordered two appetizers and two main courses. The Wagyu pastry puff was delightful, but the Canadian lobster salad didn't quite meet our expectations. As for the main courses, the baked cod and Wagyu beef tenderloin were decent, although we found ourselves comparing them to other Asian restaurants in Jeddah. It felt like they could put in more effort to stand out. On a positive note, the mocktails, especially the blooming mojito, were amazing. The dessert, passion fruit creamperle, was also enjoyable. Additionally, we appreciated the friendly reception and attentive service from the waiter. The ambiance of the restaurant was pleasant, creating a nice dining atmosphere. However, it's worth noting that the prices were on the higher side.

The restaurant boasts a cozy yet elegant ambiance that sets the perfect mood for a relaxed dining experience. I sampled several dishes, and all were delicious. The flavors were rich and vibrant. The meat kebab was tender and perfectly seasoned, cooked to perfection on the grill. The mixed grill platter was a feast for the senses, featuring an assortment of lamb, chicken, and beef kebabs alongside flavorful rice and grilled vegetables. The service was impeccable. The staff was attentive, knowledgeable about the menu, and went above and beyond to ensure a pleasant dining experience. The prices are reasonable considering the quality and portion sizes. It’s a great value for the delicious and authentic Turkish cuisine you get to enjoy. Vegetarian options: Not much as the restaurant mainly for grill dishes. But they offer a verity of salads and grilled vegs. Dietary restrictions: Frankly, not a very good option for vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, or for those who have specific allergies. Parking: Spacious parking lot located near the restaurant entrance Kid-friendliness: Fun and welcoming atmosphere for kids. It is equipped with high chairs, baby changing stations in the restrooms, and a staff that is attentive to the needs of families with infants or toddlers. Wheelchair accessibility: The restaurant has designated accessible parking spaces near the entrance, making it convenient for wheelchair users to park and enter the restaurant. The entrance itself is wide and equipped with a ramp, ensuring smooth and easy access for wheelchair users.

I visited the IKEA restaurant in Jeddah with my family and we had a great time. The restaurant offers a delicious taste of Sweden as well as some Arabic dishes. We tried the meatballs, the salmon, the shawarma and the salads and they were all fresh and tasty. The prices were reasonable and the portions were generous. The staff were friendly and helpful. The restaurant was clean and cozy. The only downside was that we had to wait in a long queue to order and find a table. It was very crowded and noisy. Also, they ran out of some items like bread and desserts. I wish they had more space and variety. Overall, I recommend the IKEA restaurant in Jeddah for anyone who wants to enjoy a good meal and shop for some quality products. It is a fun place to spend time with family or friends.

While walking near the fountain, I always used to admire the location of dilek. I fantasized about sitting there and eating delicious turkish food. So finally, I decided to eat there. And I didn't find it fascinating; neither the food nor the ambiance. Yes, the gorgeous jeddah waterfront is there, the fountain, and all, but the furniture is old. The place is oddly dimly lit. Food was just ok. I had eaten better turkish food. But the service was good. Servers were kind and helpful. So, if you eliminate the ambience and food from the restaurant, what is left? The place needs an urgent upgrade in furniture and washroom. Price-wise it's reasonable.

Ideally situated on the Middle Corniche. Perfect location for early breakfast. Cuisine is typically Arab with hints of Turkish flavor. Decently priced for a fair quantity of food. Most Turkish restaurants serve tea and a sweet as complimentary, but not here. And my heart would not concede to me paying SR7 for such a small cup so I went for the usual cappuccino. You can choose to sit in an open booth or closed booth with beautiful sliding doors. Most people want to sit at the window because of the lovely view of King Fahad’s fountain area. They have a nice system of allowing you to wait at another table until a window seat becomes available. A little under staffed it seems as service was kind of slow. Having an active concierge might make the ratings higher.

You can enjoy the crispy fries, the creamy mashed potatoes, or the fresh salad with your steak. Highly recommended! The menu has been updated with new yummy dishes so I had to check them out. The Philly Cheesesteak was incredible. Juicy, tender, full of flavor and the bread was so light it disappears in your mouth. Must try!

Wow 10/10 Finally a steakhouse worth going to in Jeddah, I had the most delightful dining experience at Steakanji Premier in Jeddah's Obhur Al-Shamaliyah. This gem of a steakhouse truly exceeded all my expectations in every aspect. Let's start with the star of the show - the steak quality. I had the pleasure of indulging in a tenderloin steak that was an absolute masterpiece. Ordered medium-well, the +4/5 MBS Australian meat was cooked to perfection, incredibly tender, and bursting with flavor. The accompanying in-house smoked barbecue sauce and white mushroom sauce elevated the dish to new heights. The fact that this was the best steak I've had in Jeddah speaks volumes about the culinary expertise at Steakanji Premier. Even the vegetables & corn sides were a delightful surprise, perfectly complementing the main course. The impeccable service deserves its own round of applause. From the moment I arrived, I was showered with warmth and attention by the staff. The complimentary shabwra & free fast Wi-Fi, were a thoughtful touch that made me feel valued & welcome. The availability of electric sockets everywhere was a clear indication that the establishment cares about its guests comfort. I was truly impressed by the dedication to creating an experience, not just a meal. The cherry on top was the complementary ice cream that was offered after the meal, a sweet ending to an unforgettable dining experience. Cleanliness was of paramount importance, and Steakanji aced it with flying colors. The spotless seats, tables, floors, restrooms, and bar were a testament to the establishment's commitment to maintaining a pristine environment for its guests. The atmosphere at the restaurant was a symphony of delights. The curated music, stunning aesthetics & decor, live kitchen, ambient lighting, and Large TVs created an ambiance that was both vibrant and relaxing. The wall adorned with backlit cows and the artistic designer (CowParade) ceramic cows added a touch of whimsy and uniqueness to the space. I was particularly intrigued by one of the ceramic cows, a one-of-a-kind red piece showcased in art festivals internationally, making the dining experience truly special. The grass walls brought a refreshing outdoor element indoors, enhancing the earthy feel of the surroundings. The atmospheric darkest-themed restrooms added a touch of mystique and elegance, creating a distinct contrast to the vibrant dining area. The inclusion of a reverse mirror and signage for selfies was a thoughtful touch that showed how much attention was paid to every little detail. The overall industrial design of Steakanji Premier tied the elements together seamlessly, creating a space that was both visually captivating and comfortable. The attention to creating a holistic dining experience, where every corner of the restaurant was carefully designed to provide a memorable moment, truly stood out. As I explored the menu further, I decided to try the seasoned rice, and it turned out to be an excellent choice. Bursting with flavor, the seasoned rice was a delightful accompaniment that further enhanced the overall meal. When it comes to value, Steakanji Premier is unparalleled. The quality and quantity of the food are simply exceptional, and considering the reasonable prices, I have yet to come across a steakhouse in Jeddah that offers better value for money. It's clear that Steakanji Premier takes pride in providing an unforgettable experience without breaking the bank. For the residents of Obhur Al-Shamaliyah, having Steakanji Premier in their vicinity is truly a stroke of luck. This franchise has truly raised the bar for steakhouses in Jeddah, setting a standard that's hard to beat. From the top-notch steak quality to the outstanding service, immaculate cleanliness, enchanting atmosphere, unparalleled comfort, exceptional attention to detail, and exceptional value, Steakanji Premier is a must-visit destination for anyone who appreciates the finer things in life. I hope Steakanji Premier keeps up the excellent work. Looking forward to the grand opening!! Vegetarian options: They had lots of salads and vegetarian sides to choose from which was cooked to perfection. Parking: The restaurant is on the 1st floor of the mall, parking can be found everywhere including 1st floor parking very close to the restaurant. Most gates have elevators next to their entrance which you can take up to reach the restaurant. Kid-friendliness: The table mats were flippable and had drownings and coloring activities, free ice cream for kids to share the happiness. Wheelchair accessibility: Doors where wide enough for wheelchairs and they had tables that are designed to accommodate them.

The place was wonderful because of the food, staff and atmosphere. There were amazing drawings and figures and the walls and there also was also some cool samurai armor. The food was wonderful and even though we got five orders of sushi and calamari, it had a pretty good price. But the best thing was the staff. There was one staff member called Charlie and he was extremely kind. He gave us Saudi champagne and some cake FOR FREE. He was very kind and always kept fixing our table up and making sure we had everything we wanted. Please show him some love and if you go there, make sure you choose him as your waiter. Me and my mother went there a couple of months ago and told him that my sister would love to be here and when we brought her, he remembered us and was very talkative. But this doesn’t mean he treated nice because he knew us, because he was treating us really nicely last time when we met him for the first time. He’s truly a great person at heart and an amazing staff member. We really need more people like him. Kid-friendliness: Children ( including me [im 14]), so teenagers and even infants were dining with me and they didn’t cause trouble and the staff didn’t mind them. Wheelchair accessibility: I saw people who unfortunately were in wheel chairs and they easily found a place to sit in and were from what I saw treated properly and fairly.

restaurant_name: مطعم أوليف جاردن جده Olive Garden Jeddah
description: The food is good,nothing special. The lasagna is basic, the salmon was fine(needed to have more flavor in it), the chicken soup was great(was served to us for free with the green salad)! However, I find the service outstanding. One of the reasons of me visiting it again is the great service. This time April was the one serving our table and she was so nice and checking up on our table frequently and never in an annoying way as some other restaurants do and we never struggled or had to wait for long to ask for something or to get what we asked for. Also she has a nice energy to bring to our table like smiling. Thank you Olive Garden for the great service staff! And special thanks to April.

restaurant_name: مطعم أوليف جاردن جده Olive Garden Jeddah
description: Prime location with nice service. Ambiance is nice, restaurant is spacious. Waiters and management are very friendly and attentive. Food gets ready very quickly, same goes for the drinks. Main courses comes with your choice of unlimited refills of soup or salad. Portions are very big. However, tastes lack authenticity. They need to upgrade some raw materials used and improve some recipes. Prices are very fair.

restaurant_name: مطعم أوليف جاردن جده Olive Garden Jeddah
description: Wonderful first experience with our waiter Lito at Olive Garden! Genuinely had a pleasant time and the food blew us away. The portions are huge!!! Honestly feels like the Entreés serve two with how big they are. I got the Cheese Ravioli and the Chicken Parmesan for mains, and the Spinach Artichoke dip for appetizers. All were stellar, especially the dip! For drinks, we had the Peach Bellini and Raspberry Lemonade that were refilled endlessly. One thing I have to mention is how incredibly attentive the staff is! They know what I want before I want it which is so perfect for a place like this. Even the music played is fun and fitting for the atmosphere. Thank you again to all the staff at this establishment! Could not have had a better time.

I entered this restaurant skeptic but Haldi amazed me in every way possible. They just don’t have authentic Indian food but the variety and tastes are just on point. I wasn’t expecting all my Indian favourites here but I did. I have been to this place twice and cannot get enough. Biryani, mango lassi, naan, dahi Bhalla are my favourite. The decor is perfect blend of Indian and Arabic design elements. You cannot miss the Darwaza and the floating candle chandelier. The staff are equally amazing. Keep up the good work and effort, Haldi team. Thank you for bringing true Indian flavours to Jeddah, not the general Masala- fied, overcooked versions of Indian food.

Good place and would recommend.

Overall good place for a fine dining experience.

Ertugal Turkish Restaurant in Al Khafji is truly a hidden gem and a must-visit dining spot for anyone in the area. As a resident of Khafji, I have had the pleasure of dining at this establishment several times, and each experience has been delightful. The restaurant offers an extensive menu that caters to all tastes and preferences, with a focus on economic and grill dishes. Whether you are a fan of succulent kebabs, flavorful grilled meats, or want to indulge in authentic Turkish cuisine, Ertugal has got you covered. The portion sizes are generous, ensuring you leave the restaurant feeling satisfied and content. One of the standout dishes at Ertugal is their signature pasta. Cooked to perfection, the pasta dishes are rich in flavor and have a unique Turkish twist that sets them apart from other Italian-inspired dishes. I highly recommend trying their Ertugal pasta; it's a culinary experience you won't want to miss. Beyond the delectable food, the restaurant's ambiance is another highlight. The spacious dining area is tastefully decorated with a mix of traditional Turkish elements and modern touches. Families and groups of friends can enjoy a warm and inviting atmosphere, while couples seeking a romantic dinner will find cozy corners to dine in. The real showstopper, however, is the courtyard with its enchanting fountains that add a touch of elegance and serenity to the overall dining experience. restaurant_name: الرومانسية جبل عمر - Al Romansiah Restaurant
description: Did you ever wonder which restaurant is the best for Arabian dishes like Mandi and Faham! Al Romansiah, undoubtedly is the best restaurant. Check out their Meat Mandi, Chicken Mandi, Faham Chicken, extra delicious and amazing flavourful white rice, bukhari rice, Maghbut chicken and the list is going on. The rice they serve with chicken mandi is extraordinary and you won’t find it anywhere else. Meat Mandi is also a must try item and I personally find the quantity of meat is low for 2 people despite the price (105 SAR). This restaurant is just opposite side of Dar Al Tawhid Intercontinental hotel and very close the Masjidul Haram. A must go restaurant in Makkah.

The Indian food in this restaurant compared with Indian food in the UK doesn’t taste the same…..this restaurant’s dishes tend to be slight more sweeter taste for their curry and sizzler dishes (only if you go for mild curry’s) while their spicy dishes are a lot more spicer than UK dishes…so bear this in mind when your ordering spicy dishes. The final bill was very expensive for Medinah….which makes me wonder if it wasn’t worth the price! Overall, the food was fantastic and enjoyable but because of the expensive price for their dishes……it was a put off!

The combination of Indian and Chinese cuisines at INDESE is a true delight for the taste buds. The flavors are rich, the portions are generous, and the service is top-notch. Absolutely loved it.

If you like Mexican, you will love Fuego. Fuego is en Fuego!.

restaurant_name: Azure Spanish Restaurant ÿ¢ÿ≤Ÿàÿ± ŸÖÿ∑ÿπŸÖ ÿ•ÿ≥ÿÿßŸÜŸä
description: Welcomed by the beautiful Carolina, who is well-informed of the menu, I was fortunate to dine her. While unfortunately it was empty, Chef Ramon de Madrid prepared a great beef cheeks dish for me. Not my usual choice, but upon the hostesses’ strong recommendation, I gave it a try. The vegetables on the side are not seasoned much but you can taste a high quality oil on them; also, good to get a set of diverse veggies in the Gulf. The bread did not taste homemade, or it was a bit too simple; the bread came with a sort of labneh-toum dip and a tomato salsa and some black/kalamata Spanish small olives. Olives were great and the labneh dip threw me off a bit, although it was good. Cannot stress how nice it was to be around a hostess and a chef who spoke Spanish. Both very nice and enjoyable people. The chef sent a complimentary chicken croquette which was nice. I intend to try the seafood paella when dining with more people eventually. That’s what this place is known for. Again; the beef cheeks were done exceptionally well, super tasty, beautifully cooked, almost like a lamb.

Verdict: Subject to further assessment of quality. Do not come for occasions but worth experiencing (negatively, in my case). Overpriced and somewhat unprofessional. Time for some brutal honesty: We ordered the bread pudding (and that is how one spells “bread pudding”, if anyone wants to know) and a berry tart. My dissatisfaction was augmented by the strange comments of the service, and the two desserts were far less than satisfactory. I was told how amazing this place (was) by my sister. We came to make my mother happy after she had a difficult time with her program (PhD). This place was a mistake. I asked for the bill first and, after, informed our waiter of certain issues that should be fixed for later service and were immediately told that cancellations are only accepted if we do not eat the food. We requested no cancellations, however, and I did not bring my mother here to save money. I wish they had seen that. The statement made regarding the bread pudding was out of genuine concern, because undercooked food is... well, unhealthy and unpopular. I never implied I wanted a cancellation or discount (because my mother was there). The response we received (from the manager via our waiter), unsolicited and in front of my mother was insensitive and indicative of a decline in reception, management and service. I should have returned the unsatisfactory desserts they gave me, and would have under other circumstances, but I was trying to avoid making a big deal out of consideration for my mother. Strangely enough, our waiter was honest and admitted that the bread pudding recipe had, in fact, changed. As for cleanliness, the place is clean (with one or two small issues/stains if you are on the balcony on the third floor). The restroom is well-scented (lavender?), but men who are seated with family upstairs must go all the way down to the ground floor to find the restroom near the exit. That is in poor taste. The hot water is room temp here, and so is the cold. I found water on the floor in the restroom I went to. This is not acceptable for the quality Madeleine seeks to project. Bread pudding: 5/10 The best part was the top. Just like a muffin, it’s the best part, but it’s not your traditional bread pudding, and therein is the fatal flaw. Once you finish the top of the their muffin/bread pudding hybrid (in which WE top it off with caramel because we customers all claim to inherently understand how the chef intended for this to taste), you begin to eat the lower layers and descend (PUN INTENDED) into lower echelons of half-baked, almost gelatinous goo. The caramel had to be poured multiple times to add flavor to these layers but did not help the texture. This is essentially a half-baked muffin whose maker forgot to mix in caramel and was too lazy to top it afterward. The ice cream on the side is the only saving grace. Tart: 1/10 This was tasteless, stale and simply terrible. The base of a tart should be crisp and thin with a soft center. This was a tough, stale biscuit. Because it was stale, it had little flavor. The cream is limited and not compatible with the overall flavor of the tart. Cheap is a term that comes to mind. The berries may be the only good thing here (cranberries are a plus, hence 1 instead of 0/10). Rosa latte: 4/10 Too sweet and far too much flavoring. The rose flavoring overpowers the coffee and turns it into some kind of candy drink. Unless you have a sweet tooth for artificial flavors, this is a "NO". French Vanilla Latte: 7/10 This was creamy, tasty and the coffee was pleasant in flavor. Perhaps slightly lacking the “French vanilla” part, but properly sweetened (just right). Restroom: 7/10 Above. Professionalism: 4/10 Above.

We had dinner last night at their Urubah branch. For appetizers, we ordered the special crab salad (there wasn't anything special with it btw), shrimp blast and the prawn gyoza (tasted like an ordinary ground beef dumpling to us, no shrimp taste). For the maki rolls, we tried their Saad which was recommended by one of the staff, crispy salmon and sweet dragon. The maki rolls were so-so, looked like they were prepared urgently because there were still spaces in between each roll especially with the crispy salmon and it was just the Saad that caught our attention. For the mains, we decided to have ramen. Expecting it to be good given the time it took to reach our table, we ended up disappointed. It was like noodles with meat and egg in hot water with just little salt in it. It was not flavorful at all. Lastly, the most disappointing part of this experience was when we took the bill, this wait staff (was not able to get the name of the Indian guy) gave an unsolicited and rude comment saying, "Why, is it expensive?" Nobody should dare say that to any customer. So I just answered him back with, "Nothing we can't handle." For the price we paid, there are other better Japanese restaurant options. The food really was not that remarkable and I think it would be the last time we will ever go there.

restaurant_name: Zafran Indian Kitchen - The View Mall
description: A Delightful Evening at Zafran Restaurant While I can't say that my taste buds were blown way by the food, the overall experience was undeniably pleasant. The true star of the evening was the exceptional service from Suddush. He was constantly attending to us if we needed anything even after the food was served. The restaurant itself boasts a lovely atmosphere. The tasteful decor, warm lightning, and comfortable seating created a perfect ambiance for an enjoyable meal for us. Despite the average food, the staff and inviting atmosphere made our visit to Zafran Restaurant a worthwhile one. If you are looking for a comfortable, friendly environment to enjoy an evening of conversation and decent Indian cuisine, this restaurant is worth considering.

Before I review the food I’d like to address the rude and pretentious female host who kept replying to us in Arabic, as if to force her personal assumptions on us, when we (an American family) were clearly speaking to her in English. Seriously, how ironic coming from a host? As for our food, the paste were good overall but bells and whistles aside, it’s pretty much at the standard of most neighborhood restaurants we go to in Italy but for 4-5x the price. We ordered linguine al frutti di mare, spaghetti alla carbonara, spaghetti Michelangelo, and spaghetti AOP, all of which were good except the AOP which tasted overwhelmingly of parmigiano. A classic aglio e olio would’ve been much better in our opinion. The crème brûlée was below average for me. A world-class restaurant should emulate world-class service and hospitality, because no one wants to eat where there’s embarrassingly unprofessional staff members, no matter how good the food may be.

I recently had the pleasure of experiencing the culinary delights of Taste of Dilli Restaurant in Riyadh through a takeout order, and I must say, it was a delightful journey for the taste buds of any Desi food lover. . One standout dish from my takeout order was the Murgh Curry. The flavors were simply outstanding, with a perfect blend of spices that created a symphony of taste. The chicken was tender and succulent, and each bite was a burst of authentic Indian flavor. It was evident that the chefs at Taste of Dilli pay great attention to detail and take pride in their craft. Accompanying the Murgh Curry, the Aloo Kulcha was a delightful addition. The soft and fluffy bread, paired with the flavorful potato filling, created a harmonious balance of textures and tastes. It was evident that the kulcha was made with care, and it added an extra layer of enjoyment to the meal. While the Butter Naan and Lacha Paratha fell slightly short of my expectations, they were still enjoyable. The naan lacked the desired buttery richness, and the lacha paratha could have been a bit more flaky. However, these minor shortcomings did not detract from the overall positive experience. Timely delivery of my meal further added to the convenience of enjoying the Taste of Dilli experience. The packaging was secure and ensured that the food arrived in excellent condition. In conclusion, Taste of Dilli Restaurant in Riyadh is a go-to destination for anyone craving authentic Desi cuisine. Even as a takeout order, the flavors transported me to the streets of Delhi, and I could taste the passion and expertise that goes into each dish. I wholeheartedly recommend Taste of Dilli to all Desi food enthusiasts who seek a memorable culinary experience. Next time you're in the mood for a flavorful journey, let Taste of Dilli bring the taste of Delhi to your doorstep.

I highly recommend this place to anyone seeking an exceptional dining experience that offers incredible value for money. It is truly a hidden gem that captures the authentic flavors of Egypt. From the moment you step foot into the restaurant, you are warmly greeted by the friendly and attentive staff, who go above and beyond to ensure your dining experience is memorable. The menu at this establishment showcases a remarkable array of original tastes from Egypt, allowing you to embark on a culinary journey like no other. Each dish is expertly prepared with the utmost care and attention to detail, highlighting the rich and vibrant flavors that Egyptian cuisine is renowned for. Whether you indulge in traditional favorites such as koshary, ful medames, or molokhia, or venture into lesser-known delicacies, you are guaranteed a gastronomic adventure that will leave your taste buds tantalized. What truly astounded me, however, was the surprisingly low price reflected on the bill for such exceptional food. It's rare to find a place that offers such high-quality dishes at such affordable prices, making it an ideal choice for budget-conscious diners without compromising on flavor or quality. In addition to the delectable food and affordable prices, the ambiance of the restaurant is warm and inviting, creating the perfect setting for a relaxed and enjoyable dining experience. The interior is tastefully decorated, capturing elements of Egyptian culture and heritage, further enhancing the authenticity of the overall experience. In conclusion, this restaurant is a true culinary gem, offering original tastes from Egypt, friendly and helpful staff, and exceptional value for money. Prepare to be impressed by the flavors, hospitality, and affordability that await you at this remarkable establishment.

King Gola This was supposed to be the highlight of my meal, but it turned out to be the biggest letdown. The Ambience The only slightly redeeming quality of this place is the ambience, which is decent at best. However, the fact that you have to climb almost two floors to reach the dining area is a major inconvenience. By the time you get there, you're already exhausted and in no mood to endure the tasteless food. Conclusion In summary, my visit to Grill and Rice Restaurant was a complete waste of time and money. The food was tasteless, and the only thing vibrant about it was the unnecessary food coloring.

Visited this place after seeing it from the busy Kharj road while passing many times as I was always intrigued by it's big glass facade and those hanging chandeliers.... I had gone there with high hope and higher expectations. The interior was nice as it appeared from outside but that was the only nice part. Since it mentioned it's speciality as Indian-Pakistani and name has Grill in it, we ordered mix chicken kebab platter, Butter chicken handi and naan. They served two tandoori rotis complimentary with each dish. There were no chutney or sauces but a very thin watery mint raita. The butter chicken came in Handi with a plastic wrap and as soon as we opened it gave weird smell. But we continued expecting taste to make up for the lack of fragrance. But alas, we were deceived. Taste was below average. There was hardly any taste of butter and I honestly can't vouch if it was cooked fresh or just heated and served in handi. Since the second dish was a grilled one, I still had a little hope left and I was expecting the seekh to be juicy and tender but it was super dry, again the same odd smell and too much of dry spice mixed in it's mince. Malai tikka didn't have malai but was the only edible thing. I really wanted to try their rice dishes but after two set backs had to cancel my plan. The food quality and taste does not match the ambiance and since it's a restaurant, owners needs to take a sincere note of it as people come to eat and not to just sit here. Staff is least involved or looks too bored to do their job. They should try to recommend items which they know are fresh and good. I doubt I'll be visiting it again. My verdict... AVOID WASTING YOUR MONEY HERE!

I’m somewhat disappointed with my experience at this restaurant. The ambiance is nice and cozy and the servers friendly and attentive that’s the good. The bad, management is not remotely familiar with hospitality and not at all responsive to customers needs. We were seated in the back section and when we sat down there was only one table with two customers. The waiter was taking to long going over every item in the menus the other table. After 10 minutes of waiting we asked to have our order taken and we were told we have to wait for this one waiter that is taking to long at the other table, 5 minutes later I flagged someone who appears to be a manger he said just a minute and then, he returned to say you have to wait for the busy waiter. I waited few more minutes and grabbed another manager who asked another waiter to come and take our order. I learned later that the first manager was actually the general manager. I’m sorry but that’s not hospitality and customer service. We ordered and the food was under whelming the vitello tonato had nice meat but the sauce was more like a deli tuna salad than a delicate sauce, with both the texture and taste disappointing. Smoked chicken salad was good but not overly creative. Our last appetizer was the four corn salad again not meeting the description of being served in a cream foam instead it turned out to be unappetizing heavy cream and truffle oil sneaked in although not in the description, and I happened not to like truffle oil. We had one dish that was successful it was the gnocchi gorgonzola and the beef short ribs was good. We finished with lemon sorbet and papa toto. I would say there are better Italian restaurants at this price point and I have no reason to return soon.

Visited Off White Restaurant & Lounge located at Riyadh Front. It's a nice lavish Labenese restaurant. The ambiance was superb with fountains around. Since it was my first visit, the host who was from Bangladesh (didn't check his name) guided very well suggested to try their one of the Chef Dishes 'Dajjaj Off White' along with 'Off White Taco' as a side dish. Dajjaj Off White was Stuffed chicken with rice served along with grilled vegetables, rice with nuts on the side and lentil sauce. Off White Taco were Crispy Tacos filled with chicken Shawarma and sauce. Overall it was very nice experience. The food was good as well as the environment.

If you go there for the first time: make  reservations in the first floor, it’s nicer. From the menu: - Fried Kebba (8/10)  كبة مقلية ٣٩ ريال - Exotic Tabbouleh (9/10) اكزوتيك تبولة ٣٨ ريال - Eggplant fetta (100/10)  فتة باذنجان ٤٤ ريال - Motabal متبل ٣١ ريال (9/10) - rice with Mozzat زر مع موزات ٩٢ ريال (10/10) - strawberry Mojito (10/10)  موهيتو فراولة ٢٩ ريال - lemonade (10/10) ليموناضة ٢٤ ريال - ( 7/10) عثملية بالماسكربوني ٤٧ ريال The total we paid: ~ 361 Sar The location is very nice, they have a garage parking, the elevator of the garage isn’t working yet, so you’ll need to take the stairs. The restaurant looked like it could be fine dining with the welcome of the hosts at the door. However they still need to work on improving their service. The welcoming at the door was on point, however when we got to the first floor we were welcomed by the host, she didn’t physically take us to the table, she pointed to few tables for us to choose from, however when we sat down we noticed it was not clean. We pointed this out to one of the servers and he moved us to another table. Our reservation was at 12:00 am and they close at 12:30. Around 12:20 our waiter disappeared without letting us know or assigning another waiter to our table. We wanted to order desserts, and we also needed our table to be cleaned before they close the kitchen. We waited for a long time to find someone that could help with that and we almost didn’t get the chance to order dessert. Suggested improvements: service needs to improve their communication with each other and with the customer. They also need to be around the customer more. The food was very fast to arrive to our table. It would’ve been better to wait a bit between appetizers and main course. I am aware the restaurant just opened and those things happen during the opening month. I will wait for a month or two and visit again to see if the service changes. Other than that everything was perfect, the food was great and the place was nice too.

I recently had the pleasure of dining in this restaurant, and I must say that it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. From the moment I stepped foot into the restaurant, I was greeted with warm smiles and a welcoming ambiance that set the tone for an unforgettable evening. The first thing that caught my attention was the elegant and modern decor. The interior design was tastefully done, creating a cozy yet sophisticated atmosphere. The lighting was just right, allowing for a relaxed and intimate dining experience. Moving on to the highlight of the evening - the food. Helo Restaurant truly exceeded my expectations in terms of culinary excellence. The menu offered a wide variety of dishes, each crafted with utmost care and attention to detail. Whether you're a meat lover or a vegetarian, there is something to satisfy every palate. I started my meal with their signature appetizer, the crispy calamari. The dish arrived beautifully presented and tasted as good as it looked. The calamari was perfectly cooked, tender on the inside with a delightful crunch on the outside. It was accompanied by a tangy dipping sauce that complemented the flavors wonderfully. For my main course, I opted for their grilled salmon with lemon butter sauce. The salmon fillet was cooked to perfection - moist and flaky with a subtle smoky flavor from the grill. The lemon butter sauce added a refreshing zing to every bite, enhancing the natural flavors of the fish. To complete this exquisite dining experience, I indulged in their decadent chocolate lava cake for dessert. As soon as I cut into it, warm chocolate oozed out from within - pure bliss! It was rich, velvety smooth, and paired perfectly with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. What truly sets Helo Restaurant apart is not only their delectable cuisine but also their impeccable service. The staff was attentive, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond to ensure that every aspect of my dining experience was flawless. They were more than happy to accommodate any dietary restrictions or preferences, making me feel valued as a guest. Overall, my experience at Helo Restaurant was nothing short of exceptional. The combination of delectable food, elegant ambiance, and outstanding service makes it a must-visit for any food enthusiast. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply looking for an extraordinary dining experience, Helo Restaurant is the perfect choice. I cannot wait to return and explore more of their culinary delights.

We had the sashimi omakase platter the sashimi was very thick that was ent to my liking, specially with the commercial quality of the fish. Would give it another chance but not a recommendation at the moment. With the price you would pay you can go to a proper Japanese restaurant in Riyadh and get a way better experience in terms of food and atmosphere. One comment that I do agree is very silly but the soy sauce was very dense and dark for a reason I guess they use dark soy sauce instead of Japanese sushi soy sauce which is milder and lighter in color. Same went for the wasabi at the same price at other establishment you get fresh real wasabi instead of the hard green play dough we got.

After hearing numerous positive reviews, I finally decided to give this place a try. Arriving a bit early on the weekend, we were fortunate to snag a lovely central seat in this bustling spot. The interior is wonderfully designed, boasting a high ceiling that imparts a spacious feel. The menu predominantly features Mediterranean dishes with subtle hints of Eastern influence. We kicked off with the Crunchy Kale Salad, Musakhan Popsicles, and Eggplant Fatta. Moving on to the main course, we indulged in the Crispy Ouzi Balls and the Kumar Butter Chicken. The presentation was appealing, and the flavors were remarkably well-balanced, offering a delightful combination of freshness. The service was both friendly and impressively professional. We had a special request not to have all the food served simultaneously, and they executed it flawlessly. To cap off our feast, we ordered the Hakuna Matata ice cream dessert, a delightful surprise that I'll leave for you to savor. In my black book, this place easily earns a spot among my top 5 restaurants in Riyadh, thanks to its beautiful decor, delicious food, and impeccable service.

"Paella Perfection" I've had the pleasure of dining at this restaurant four times before writing this, and I must say, their Paella is nothing short of 5-star! Every time the seafood Paella arrived, it was a sizzling masterpiece in the pan, a riot of colorful ingredients and aromas. Mussels, prawns, octopus, and chicken, studded with green beans, cherry tomatoes, and slices of lime. Every bite was a sheer delight. The Paella is moister than the usual, which is surprisingly good, yet you still get that perfect crunch with the "socarrat." The restaurant boasts a delightful ambiance, and the service is simply fantastic. If you're looking for another dish to try, I highly recommend the beef Ossobucco. The welcome drink and bread compliments the whole experience.

description: As there was hype of their breakfast I went with my 2 teenage kids. We ordered Halwa puri 4 out of 10. Nehari 1 out of 10, it was not Nehari it was just just a kind of salan with excessive oil and red chillies. Channa and aloo tarkari was taste less, no salt at all. Paratha was OK, Thery need to improve their breakfast quality. Putting oil and spice is not called flavour or taste. That was my bad experience of breakfast with them. Sitting and ambiance is good. The taste I experienced for breakfast, will never recommend. There are other better options for breakfast in Riyadh.

description: The Pros Decent food taste. Spices are on the low side, as long as you like that. Ridiculously diverse menu. Not sure how long they can maintain it. You can try Chinese items as well. Which we didn't try. Wait time for food was reasonable. Bbq items were quite good. Roti was nice and fresh. The Cons Good luck finding parking here in the evening on weekend. We ordered sheep karahi. I was hoping for bit more transparency when ordering. If you don't have sheep meat. Say so. Don't lie to the customer. Might come here once with family again. It's just bit far south of riyadh to come here more regularly.

Okay this is one of the best grill restaurants in Riyadh. Usually the Shish Taouk in othe restaurants is dry and a little bit tough to eat, but here, it melts in your mouth, full of juices, and full of taste. The beef kebab here  hits all points one would look for in beef kebab. You know how good a restaurant is from their appetisers, and this one didn't disappoint. Usually restaurants don't care about the appetisers but focus on the main dish, but here everything is home made and fresh, one can't ask for more. All of the dishes I have tried are up to standard that I had in mind. Service is really good, waiters are polite, the guy that took our order was okay. Hygiene and cleaness of the restaurant is very good. Would recommend for anyone looking for a Syrian/Arabic grill restaurant/food.

I recently dined at Bab Tuma, a restaurant that is known for serving chicken broast and shawarma. While I must admit that the shawarma didn't quite live up to my expectations, the chicken broast at Bab Tuma was truly exceptional. The broast was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, bursting with flavors that left me craving for more. It was definitely the highlight of my meal.On the downside, the shawarma at Bab Tuma didn't quite satisfy my taste buds. The flavors were lacking, and the overall taste was average compared to other shawarma joints. However, the standout quality of their chicken broast compensates for this disappointment.Considering the exceptional broast and the average shawarma, I would rate Bab Tuma a solid 4 out of 5 stars. The delicious chicken broast alone makes it worth a visit, but if you're specifically craving shawarma, you may want to explore other options. Overall, Bab Tuma offers a decent dining experience, especially if you're a fan of well-cooked and flavorful chicken broast. Service was average. I had to ask for my food after it was setting ready for a couple of minutes. Directions were not given at all. Also, people failed to give a smiling welcoming gesture. Parking: It is very tough to find a parking spot at times of rush.

restaurant_name: مطعم سمك ورز للمأكولات البحرية (Fish & Rice Seafood Restaurant)
description: One of the best seafood restaurant in the Eastern region. The starter soup itself gave us the warm spoonful of sea comfort. Even though the fresh fishes are kept in the fridge front end, there is no any bad smelling how I wonder and this shop is cleanliness at its best. Even though the refrigerator where the fresh fish is stored can be seen upfront, there wasn’t any odor that bothered us, and this store is exceptionally clean. The special sauce they gave was amazing for dipping the shrimp for quick bites. The shrimps was cooked well with their tails and heads which was nice to see and photograph. The fish was mouthwatering with the rice below. The ambiance inside the restaurant was nice, this place is a must try for family eating. They have table and majlis seating.

I hope you continue like this and develop more, and I hope you open more than one branch in the Kingdom, especially Mecca 😅✨.

May the peace, blessings, and mercy of God be upon you Hawawshi Restaurant Karachi Located in Mecca, the end of the Al-Sabhani line towards Al-Laith Road I was hesitant to go there, but after the experience the situation was very different The general atmosphere of the place, from the moment you enter the restaurant, you notice the cleanliness of the place and the tables. The restaurant is small and does not have a large number of tables. It is classified as a popular restaurant rather than an upscale restaurant, but the surprising thing is that they treat their customers better than some upscale restaurants. To be honest, I paid the food money after I ate, and some upscale restaurants take the money afterward. They bring you food The general atmosphere of the place is very beautiful, with some artists’ drawings on the walls, some beautiful phrases, and some old fezzes pasted on the ceiling As for the food, God willing, God bless you, the hawawshi they have is delicious and beautiful, and one of the best hawawshi I ate in Mecca and Jeddah. The stuffed pigeon tastes amazing and beautiful, and the pigeon does not smell rancid, meaning it is well cleaned. Their moussaka is very beautiful, and they serve it to you in a pottery casserole dish, and molokhiya as well, and the most important thing is that they prepare the frying beautifully. They have orzo soup and pigeon soup that are worth trying, delicious, useful, filling and nutritious. In short, anyone who wants to eat, enjoy and be nourished has nothing but a crunchy Hawawshi restaurant. The workers are good, helpful and tidy, especially the cashier, God willing, they are very polite and ethical, and they are also generous, because after eating we were offered free rice pudding without asking for anything, and he told us this was hospitality from the store. As for the prices, they are good, nice and thoughtful, and in relation to the amount of food served, it is considered suitable for everyone and not exaggerated Thank you Hawawshi Crunchy Restaurant Thank you to the restaurant owner for his success by choosing good workers Thank you to all the workers for their efforts and ethics, especially the cashier After the experience, which will be repeated, God willing, on a weekly basis, yes, I advise everyone to try the place and enjoy the beautiful, nutritious and useful food. Vegetarian options: Not available at all. Restaurant for meat lovers Dietary restrictions: Honestly, eating them is nutritious and beneficial Parking: There is inconvenient parking in front of the store and there is a lot of parking on the street Kid-friendliness: Not suitable for children. There are no special meals for children Wheelchair accessibility: Access for a wheelchair is tiring and very difficult if cars are parked at the door of the restaurant, especially since the restaurant is high

I gotta say, I’m surprised with all the fuss and the good reviews. I honestly say it’s overrated. I have been here in a seafood night (that’s thursday) and I rarely have any expectations when I visit somewhere new. But as a reputation as Ritz-Carlton, this restaurant has not reached to a “hotel” restaurant expectation. To be fair, I am not big fan of buffets. However; it did not have a lot of varieties. My soup was not hot. The service was decent, and their drinks are amazing. Try their Radiant Rose drink. One of the main reason that I did not like this place, is the type of guests around here. You could expect that this place will be visited by high class visitors, but it was the contrary. Many children are running around, and people are talking in high voices, and there are a lot of native minority people with bad dressing and slippers, I could advise that they should put on a dress code. I am not saying this restaurant is bad, but it is not outstanding.

In general, I give the restaurant 3 stars for the atmosphere and service only. As for the food, it is normal or below normal for this price category, and there is the bad, and what makes it worst is its price. I tried 3 chicken burgers (buffalo - grilled - dill), all of them were ordinary, and I give them a 7/10. The grilled burger is very ordinary and does not have anything special from other restaurants, and the buffalo is okay, but as for the dill, I can say it is special, and I can give it a 7.5/10. I also ordered the Lab Hot salad and it was good to be honest, but it had a lot of acidity, but it was a good salad. I give it an 8/10. But the worst thing I tried was the brisket. The brisket came beautifully presented with half a coconut, vegetables, and mashed potatoes on the side. But the brisket tasted bland or stale, meaning it lacked some spices, especially the barbecue sauce on it. It had a mild, bitter taste, but the worst thing about the meat was that it was tough and chewy to the point where you would hate it. The vegetables were also somewhat tough and seasoned or tasteless, as for the potatoes. The mashed one had a light texture and had no taste at all, as it did not contain even a hint of salt or pepper. The restaurant, frankly, does not deserve the praise it receives, nor does it deserve a second visit. I paid approximately 200 riyals for this visit, and I do not think it deserves it in general.

A nice restaurant serving authentic Turkish cuisine, with good taste, ample quantity, fast service, fairly priced, and somewhat of a decent ambiance. Menu is available on your phone through scanning a QR code printed on the table mat. Food was served fresh and within 15 minutes. Food taste was very good, the meat items were perfectly grilled, were tender, and had a nice Turkish flavor. The Turkish bread was also baked to perfection. The service was fast and prompt but the staff lacks the courteous behavior anticipated from restaurant staff. Prices are normal to what you would expect at a restaurant of this standard. The ambiance is slightly on the darker side which was confusing given several alleys and compartments in the family section of the restaurant. Also it’s hard to navigate through the restaurant and no staff member could speak or understand English so was a challenge for guests. This restaurant is pretty popular among the expat community and comes highly recommended.

Food taste was very good, the meat items were perfectly grilled, were tender, and had a nice Turkish flavor. The Turkish bread was also baked to perfection. The service was fast and prompt but the staff lacks the courteous behavior anticipated from restaurant staff. Prices are normal to what you would expect at a restaurant of this standard. The ambiance is slightly on the darker side which was confusing given several alleys and compartments in the family section of the restaurant. Also it’s hard to navigate through the restaurant and no staff member could speak or understand English so was a challenge for guests. This restaurant is pretty popular among the expat community and comes highly recommended.

Assaraya was introduced to me by my husband as I am new to the country. I have been here on 2 occasions and I did not leave disappointed. We are a family of 5, 3 kids and 2 adults. The menu offered a variety of dishes which made ordering for picky kids quite easy. We ordered a mix grill, chicken, fries and an appetiser of baba ghanoush with the turkish bread. We ordered a few different drinks to sample which was affordable accompanied with our water which was cheap. Every dish was delicious and tasy especially the mixed grill. The chops was soft and succulent and reminded me of home. We ordered a big portion of fries which we were surprised to see that it was actually the size of a single serving. The fries were served with tomato sauce (ketchup) and their homemade garlic sauce which is the BEST garlic sauce I have ever had in Riyadh. You can taste that it was prepared in-house with fresh garlic. It has the consistency and texture of a soft paste. On both occasions I asked to take the sauce home :) The staff were friendly and hospitable and we loved that they offered dining behind a curtain for extra privacy for myself and my daughters. The food was served fast and quick which is a bonus for hungry diners. Assaraya is definitely one of our favourite restaurants in Riyadh and will see us more often.

restaurant_name: Dosa Corner ( Lulu Khurais Food Court)
description: My recent visit to Dosa Corner at Lulu Hypermarket, Khurais left me thoroughly impressed. The dosas served here were simply amazing, and the variety available was mind-boggling. I had the pleasure of trying the Mexican Salsa dosa, Tomato Masala dosa, and the Pizza dosa, and each one was a delightful explosion of flavors. The dosas were prepared to perfection, with a crispy yet soft texture that was absolutely mouthwatering. The Mexican Salsa dosa had just the right amount of spice, and the combination of flavors was incredible. The Tomato Masala dosa was packed with a rich and tangy tomato-based masala that was a true delight for the taste buds. And the Pizza dosa, well, it was like having a pizza in the form of a dosa! The fusion of Indian and Italian flavors was a unique and delicious experience. Aside from the outstanding dosas, I must commend the staff at Dosa Corner. They were extremely friendly, attentive, and helpful in guiding us through the menu and suggesting the best dosas to try. Their knowledge and passion for their food were evident, and it added to the overall enjoyable experience. Moreover, the cleanliness and neatness of the establishment were highly commendable. The restaurant was well-maintained, creating a pleasant and inviting atmosphere for diners. It was evident that hygiene and cleanliness were given top priority. To top it all off, the filter coffee served at Dosa Corner was excellent. Its rich aroma and perfect balance of flavors provided the ideal ending to a fantastic meal. In conclusion, if you're a dosa lover or simply looking for an extraordinary culinary experience, Dosa Corner at Lulu Hypermarket, Khurais is a must-visit. With their extensive dosa menu, friendly staff, and impeccable cleanliness, this place truly stands out. I highly recommend trying their wide range of dosas and enjoying a cup of their delightful filter coffee. You won't be disappointed!

restaurant_name: هاس كرال مطعم و كافيه مختص HASKRAL Restaurant and Speciality Cafe
description: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Haskral, I can confidently say it’s the best Turkish restaurant in the area. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted with warm hospitality and an inviting ambiance that sets the stage for an unforgettable culinary experience. The menu is a delightful journey through traditional Turkish cuisine, offering a variety of dishes that cater to all tastes. For the main course, I opted for the Adana Kebab. The meat was tender, juicy, and seasoned to perfection, served with fragrant rice and a side of grilled vegetables. The portion sizes were generous, ensuring that you get great value for your money. The highlight of the meal was the Baklava dessert. Layers of thin, crispy pastry filled with a rich nut mixture and drenched in sweet syrup, it was the perfect ending to a fantastic meal. The service was impeccable throughout the evening. The staff were attentive, knowledgeable, and eager to provide recommendations. The restaurant’s décor also deserves a mention, with its elegant yet cozy interior that makes you feel right at home. In conclusion, Haskral is a gem in Al Taif, offering an authentic Turkish dining experience that is second to none. Whether you’re a local resident or a visitor, this restaurant is a must-visit for anyone looking to enjoy delicious Turkish cuisine in a welcoming

The food was delicious, but the service needed to be modified a little. As for the service, of course, no one comes to take orders from you while you are sitting. You have to go to the cashier and ask (OK, that's no problem, but at least come and meet him, or if you see me sitting and waiting for someone to come and take the order from me for 10 minutes, tell me it's okay, you have to ask the cashier). But other than that, the service was impeccable. As for the food, be honest, get creative even though the restaurant is small, but the food is delicious Especially the ramen with chicken, once delicious, the broth is full of flavors and spices, and the noodles are soft and cheap. I also ordered the fried potato balls, they were ok and tasted crispy. The dynamite shrimp is drenched in sauce and tastes delicious and crunchy, but the pieces are small, but that's not a problem for me, it was delicious. As for sushi, I ordered the fashion roll and the plain basic was sufficient. The second special sushi was frankly delicious and had a distinctive taste. I recommend it. In general, I recommend this restaurant because it is small, delicious, and cheap for a Japanese restaurant. My advice, to complement the authentic Japanese experience, is that they add nigiri sushi to the menu. Thanks.

Unfortunately, such an offer was not made, and the evening was ruined. I was disappointed with the way this situation was handled. I hope the restaurant improves its customer service and attention in the future.
